verdict.rationale: Dots' own docs say you can connect email, calendar, and files apps during setup or later. Gmail is used to find relevant email and Google Drive to read and update documents, and existing ChatGPT app permissions govern that access. Missing for 10: any documented detail on how calendar data is searched or used beyond the setup mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration of connector search quality.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers

citations.quote: connect Gmail to find relevant email, Google Drive to read and update documents
Connect apps such as email, calendar, and files, or skip this step and add them later.
Your existing ChatGPT app permissions apply to your dot. For example, you can allow it to read email without allowing it to send email.
